enabling_facts: when the process environment has no DATABASE_URL, load_dotenv injects the .env DATABASE_URL, so the effective target is the development database
the incident attempt supplied the pytest-contract DATABASE_PATH instead of the launcher-contract DATABASE_URL; the app never consulted DATABASE_PATH because .env already provided DATABASE_URL
no launcher component validated the effective database target before the write-capable steps ran
root_cause: the launcher contract required an explicit isolated DATABASE_URL in the process environment, but nothing enforced it: with DATABASE_URL absent, .env (DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///data/writing_feedback.db) silently selected the development database, and run.bat ran migrate/initialize/smoke-stack against it before any verification logic
why_not_rejected: missing process-environment DATABASE_URL: load_settings accepts the .env value and never errors
DATABASE_PATH-only isolation: DATABASE_PATH is ignored once .env DATABASE_URL exists, so the wrong-variable mistake silently selected the development database
resolution to data/writing_feedback.db: no code path checked the resolved target
